content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Let's examine the current options for selling digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal. Gumroad is a popular platform for creators, but it has its limitations, such as transaction fees and limited customization options. Lemon Squeezy is another alternative, but it's not available in all countries, including Nigeria and Ghana. Meanwhile, NOWPayments offers a more flexible solution, with 300+ cryptocurrencies supported, no KYC requirements, and automatic payment verification. However, the infrastructure is much more complex and requires a higher level of technical expertise.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal's restrictions on certain countries are well-documented, but what about the alternatives? Gumroad, for instance, has its own set of restrictions, while Lemon Squeezy is not available in some countries. NOWPayments, on the other hand, has a more open approach, supporting a wide range of cryptocurrencies and allowing creators to sell digital products without relying on traditional payment gateways. This is where sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in, providing a permanent structural alternative to the likes of Stripe and PayPal.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, NOWPayments stands out from the competition. With automatic payment verification and a wide range of cryptocurrencies supported, transactions are processed quickly and efficiently. Meanwhile, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive solution for creators, with a more transparent pricing structure and better control over payment speeds. This is where the real cost of using Stripe or PayPal becomes apparent, with fees ranging from 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction to 3.4% + $0.30 per transaction.
Stripe's geographic exclusion list is a deliberate infrastructure decision — not a temporary gap waiting to be fixed.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the key benefits of sovereign commerce infrastructure is the level of control it offers creators. With NOWPayments, you can automate payment verification and delivery, while also maintaining full ownership of your digital products. This is in stark contrast to the likes of Stripe and PayPal, which often take a more centralized approach to commerce. Meanwhile, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive solution for creators, with automation and delivery options built-in from the start.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

So, which architecture should you choose for selling digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal? The answer depends on your specific needs and circumstances. If you're looking for a more flexible solution with a wide range of cryptocurrencies supported, NOWPayments may be the way to go. However, if you're looking for a more comprehensive solution with automation and delivery options built-in, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) may be a better fit.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Sovereign infrastructure means no single platform decision can cut off your income — the store runs under your own accounts.

If you're looking for a more flexible solution with a wide range of cryptocurrencies supported, check out NOWPayments. Or, if you're looking for a more comprehensive solution with automation and delivery options built-in, consider Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Either way, you can start selling digital products today by visiting our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.

NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it a more cost-effective option for creators compared to traditional payment gateways.

While NOWPayments does require some technical expertise, the platform offers a range of resources and support to help creators get started. Additionally, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more comprehensive solution with automation and delivery options built-in.

Edge Commerce Stack ($197) can be deployed in just 48 hours, making it a fast and efficient solution for creators.
Can I sell digital products on multiple platforms at once?
Yes, you can. With NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you have access to two comprehensive solutions that allow you to sell digital products on multiple platforms at once.
What happens if my account is suspended by a traditional payment gateway?
With NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you have control over your own commerce infrastructure, making it less likely that you'll be affected by account suspensions or other issues.
The stack that runs on Cloudflare and a blockchain cannot be suspended by anyone else's compliance team.
